radiusException.reason: ItemMedia's Icon/Image variant corners are a fixed internal-composition detail of that variant's own visual identity, not an independently-tunable surface (the enclosing Item's own radius prop covers the row itself)

inspirationNote: Core card-like treatment (border, bg-card, hover:bg-accent) is consistent with shadcn's tokens; shadcn v4 restructured Item into a much larger subcomponent family (ItemMedia/ItemHeader/ItemFooter/etc.) adico's single-component composition doesn't replicate, an independent scope choice. dioxus-components uses CSS modules (external style.css files), not Tailwind, so no Tailwind class-level comparison is possible there.
